## PR 550

**Band mapping — one band per area, simple**

**বাংলায়:** তিনটা ডেলিভারি ব্যান্ড: ঢাকা সিটি (সিটি কর্পোরেশনের ম্যাপ), আপনার সাব-এরিয়া তালিকা, বাকি দেশ এক চার্জ; অ্যাডমিনে চার্জ বসানোর পেজ।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-22
  - Build status row: band mapping: Dhaka City = the DNCC + DSCC map (setting `delivery.bands.cityCorporations`), the owner's sub-area list (AreaBand rows, empty), one flat outside band; admin `/admin/delivery` (three bands, sub-area list, Try an address); permissions `delivery.read`, `delivery.charges`, `delivery.areas`; bands ship off with no charge
  - GitHub pull request #22, 22 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **Band mapping** — one band per area, simple. **Dhaka City = the official DNCC + DSCC map**, nothing else. Sub-area = the owner's list, which is the only exception to the map. Everywhere else is one flat rate. The charge the customer sees is a figure the owner fixes in the admin — it does not depend on which courier the parcel ends up on. The sub-area band has three settings: its own charge · folded into Dhaka City · folded into the outside-Dhaka flat charge.

## PR 551

**Ambiguity resolver — reads the whole line, and waits**

**বাংলায়:** পুরো ঠিকানা পড়ে ব্যান্ড ঠিক হয়; একই নামের দুই জায়গা হলে কাস্টমারকে জিজ্ঞেস করে, আন্দাজ করে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-22
  - Build status row: ambiguity resolver: reads the whole line after `delivery.resolver.settleMs` (900 ms) or blur, asks "Where is this address?" only when still ambiguous; admin Try-an-address; resolve APIs
  - GitHub pull request #22, 22 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **Ambiguity resolver — reads the whole line, and waits.** Nothing is decided while the cursor is still in the address field: people write the district a few words later ("Gabtoli Bus Stand, **Dhaka**"; "Masterpara, Gabtali, **Bogura**"). On blur, or a long enough pause, the resolver reads the complete address — a district, parent area or postcode anywhere in it settles the band **silently, with no question**. A postcode settles it (1216 Dhaka, 5820 Bogura); a co-occurring local name narrows it; a returning customer's saved address outranks any guess. **Only a line still ambiguous after that full read asks**, and once the customer confirms, nothing silently changes it.
- **Filed under:** [S06 additions — the delivery-zone engine (§60, 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (round 15, no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-606): **PR 550 / 551 (delivery bands + resolver)** — built into the demo 19 Oct from BD-AREA-MASTER.csv (generator `data/tools/make-gazetteer.py`); data fixes: Gazipur and Narayanganj district rows added, Dinajpur's Nawabganj upazila corrected to outside Dhaka, "Bogra" alias added, bare "Nawabganj" removed from Chapai Nawabganj. Delivery time shown in **hours** per band (24–48 inside, 48–72 outside), editable.
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017):** simulation finding SIM-F-003 (the shown delivery charge is not the stored one) is a required acceptance test of this PR; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Settings and named keys: `delivery.resolver.settleMs`
- **Owning agent:** Gyani

## PR 555

**Phone-first recognition at checkout — the customer has given a phone number before he has given anything else**

**বাংলায়:** শুধু ফোন নম্বর দিলে এলাকা আগে থেকে বসে; পুরো ঠিকানা আসে কেবল SMS কোড বা লগইনের পর।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-22
  - Build status row: phone-first recognition `POST /api/delivery/phone-area`: one BD phone helper; a bare number prefills the area only, per-IP limit (`delivery.phoneFirst.rateLimit` 10 / 600 s); the full address needs a session or an SMS code
  - GitHub pull request #22, 22 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **Phone-first recognition at checkout** — the customer has given a phone number before he has given anything else. It is looked up even with no login, because most people never log in. **A bare phone number prefills the area only** — enough to set the charge, and not sensitive. House, road and full address prefill only after a one-time SMS code or a real login, so a stranger typing numbers cannot harvest customers' addresses.
- **Filed under:** [S06 additions — the delivery-zone engine (§60, 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017):** simulation findings SIM-F-015 (the identity check sees only the phone number); SIM-F-037 (staff cannot correct a phone number with a log) are required acceptance tests of this PR; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `POST /api/delivery/phone-area`
  - Settings and named keys: `delivery.phoneFirst.rateLimit`
- **Owning agent:** Gyani
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct) · Demo: screen `#/checkout` in [the demo](../demo/EXTAS-demo-V12.3.html) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s06--fraud--location--in-progress) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 556

**In-transit duplicate notice — the moment the phone number identifies an order already on its way with the same product, colour and size, …**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “জালিয়াতি ঠেকানো আর লোকেশন” ধাপের অংশ: ভুয়া আর ডুপ্লিকেট অর্ডার ধরা, আর ঠিকানা দেখে সঠিক ডেলিভারি চার্জ বের করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **In-transit duplicate notice** — the moment the phone number identifies an order already on its way with the same product, colour and size, a Bengali popup with the product photo, the earlier order number and its tracking link: *it has already reached your area, there is no need to order again.* **Two buttons — cancel it, or "no, I want another one"** — because the second one is sometimes a real sale. Every firing is recorded in detail, with the campaign that brought the customer, so a campaign generating duplicates can have its frequency cap cut.
- **Filed under:** [S06 additions — the delivery-zone engine (§60, 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct)

## PR 559

**Phone-entry risk check — our database and the courier fraud checks queried in the background while the customer keeps typing**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “জালিয়াতি ঠেকানো আর লোকেশন” ধাপের অংশ: ভুয়া আর ডুপ্লিকেট অর্ডার ধরা, আর ঠিকানা দেখে সঠিক ডেলিভারি চার্জ বের করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Phone-entry risk check** — our database and the courier fraud checks queried **in the background while the customer keeps typing**. Never blocks the form; a slow or failed check **passes the customer**. It catches a pattern, not a slip: 20 orders with 5–8 cancelled is not a flag; five parcels from several couriers all cancelled is. Recency weighted.
- **Filed under:** [S06 additions — the delivery-zone engine (§60, 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017):** simulation finding SIM-F-015 (the identity check sees only the phone number) is a required acceptance test of this PR; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-018):** risk rules the owner builds (past RTO, courier success ratio, new phone, area, order value, repeated cancels, with weights); Hard = full advance, Soft = delivery charge in advance, a partial-advance option; never auto-block; Orders → Risk rules.
- **Owning agent:** Gyani
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s06--fraud--location--in-progress) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 562

**Flag outcome report — of the customers flagged: how many paid the advance, how many abandoned**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “জালিয়াতি ঠেকানো আর লোকেশন” ধাপের অংশ: ভুয়া আর ডুপ্লিকেট অর্ডার ধরা, আর ঠিকানা দেখে সঠিক ডেলিভারি চার্জ বের করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Flag outcome report** — of the customers flagged: how many paid the advance, how many abandoned. **This is the number that tunes the parameter.** If most of them walk away, the threshold is costing more than it saves, and the owner can see that in a week rather than guessing for a year.
- **Filed under:** [S06 additions — the delivery-zone engine (§60, 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s06-additions--the-delivery-zone-engine-60-18-oct)

## PR 567

**Multi-courier fraud data — Steadfast's and Pathao's own checks to begin with, and any aggregated source behind the same adapter**

**বাংলায়:** শিগগির — এখনো বানানো হয়নি। “জালিয়াতি ঠেকানো আর লোকেশন” ধাপের অংশ: ভুয়া আর ডুপ্লিকেট অর্ডার ধরা, আর ঠিকানা দেখে সঠিক ডেলিভারি চার্জ বের করা।

**Details**

- **Status:** Filed (not built yet)
- **What it does (original scope):** **Multi-courier fraud data** — Steadfast's and Pathao's own checks to begin with, and any aggregated source behind the same adapter. A customer's refusal history is spread across couriers and none of them share it, so the adapter merges whatever is connected into one view and draws the maximum from it.
